text:
jamie: Kicking off the deploy window for feature flag llm_routing_v4. Plan: enable 10% (cohort=beta) for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then 100% if green. Tagging @oncall @sre. Release notes updated (see link) and rollback steps below.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by jamie at 2026-03-23T15:12:03Z. Actions queued:
 - ff: llm_routing_v4 -> cohort:beta pct:10
 - image: redwood/infer:v4.2.3 -> pool-prod-a
Health gates: latency_p95 < 200ms, error_rate < 0.5%. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 1% for 2m. Use `/deploy cancel` to halt.

sven: Quick ask — can we pin the fallback route to model-route:v3.9 for 1h while we watch? prevents noisy backfills if we rollback.

jamie: yes pin in case of urgent rollback. command for ops console: ```ops pin-route llm_route --version v3.9 --ttl 1h```

marie: I'll watch tracing and smoke evals. Gate we care about: rerank_quality (top1 drift < 1.5%) and generation latency. Posting dashboard link in #eng-releases.

dave: If memory or KV cache errors spike do immediate roll to 0%. Quick rollback snippet: ```/ff set llm_routing_v4 --pct 0 --reason "emergency rollback"```

oncall: acked. I'll stay on watch for the first 30m and escalate to SRE if any surge over thresholds.

deploy-bot: Feature flag llm_routing_v4 set to cohort=beta pct=10 (3160709185). Canary traffic flowing.

jamie: 5m check-in — no visible error spikes. moving to 50% at +15m if still clean. :thumbsup:

marie: Observability note after 8m: p95 latency +12ms, error rate 0.12%. rerank_quality drift 0.4% — within gate. Logging a short eval run.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 50% (3160709220). Changes applied.

jamie: 50% looks stable at +6m. sticking to the ramp plan, will push to 100% in 10m unless anything changes. leaving pin in place for fallback.

marie: One minor noise: token-per-request SLO dipped ~4% for a minute but recovered. Noted in release notes.

jamie: pushing to 100% now. once complete we'll update release notes and mark the change window closed.

deploy-bot: llm_routing_v4 set to 100% (3160709255). Image redwood/infer:v4.2.3 fully deployed to pool-prod-a. Auto-rollback not triggered.

dave: Nice. leaving a follow-up: add the pin+rollback timeline to the changelog so support knows where to route incidents.

jamie: Done — release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/llm_routing_v4-4.2.3 (includes rollback command snippets and pinned fallback info). Closing window and leaving flag enabled. Thanks all :rocket:

oncall: Acknowledged. I'll file a short one-pager with the decision matrix for future ramp windows and link to this thread.

marie: Adding a short regression test to the nightly evals to catch the token-per-request dip next time.

jamie: Good call. Closing thread.
